mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for a library renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for a library renovation involves several steps to ensure a smooth project. Start by decluttering and temporarily relocating any furniture or personal items from the work area. If existing shelving is being removed, clear out all books and other contents. A crucial preparation step is to clarify your vision and gather inspiration images or specific requirements you have for the space. This helps our design team create a plan that perfectly matches your expectations. We also advise discussing access routes and any necessary protection for adjacent living areas with our team before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a library renovation by decluttering the space, relocating items, and clearing existing shelves. Clarify your design vision and discuss access routes and protection for other areas with the construction team.
